result.title: TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine
result.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TCMScience，一个面向中医的自主科研知识发现 agent：架构由 trusted kernel、scientific compiler 与 claim-support contracts 组成，把语言模型的提案与执行、发布权限分离，并配以大规模连接器与数据目录，报告了网络药理学分析与治理消融实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据契约 + 权限边界」把提案与发布分离的做法，可能启发 LVR 中如何判定答案是否有视觉证据支持、何时停止取证；而背景集合变化使显著通路由 66 变为 0 的结果，可供核查为「证据筛选改变结论」的类比线索。
